Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
refactor: Config-driven model architecture (max 3 per provider)

Refactored the model system to be completely config-driven:
- Models now loaded from /etc/fazai/fazai.conf as single source of truth
- Maximum 3 models per provider enforced and organized by type
- Fallback to built-in defaults if config unavailable
- Support for Ollama, OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google providers
- New Model interface with description field for better UX

Configuration entries:
- MODELS_OLLAMA=model1,model2,model3 (local, max 3)
- MODELS_OPENROUTER=model1,model2,model3 (cloud, max 3)
- MODELS_OPENAI=model1,model2,model3 (cloud, max 3)
- MODELS_ANTHROPIC=model1,model2,model3 (cloud, max 3)
- MODELS_GOOGLE=model1,model2,model3 (cloud, max 3)

Updated all 6 consistency matrix items:
1. Help text (app.ts)
2. Bash completion (completion/fazai-completion.bash)
3. Config file (fazai.conf.example, /etc/fazai/fazai.conf)
4. Installer (already mentions models)
5. Documentation (README.md - new "🎯 Modelos Disponíveis" section)
6. Changelog (CHANGELOG.md)

🤖 Generated with Claude Code

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
